title: Sexual Timing in Couples Actively Trying to Conceive
brief_summary: This study will asses the effectiveness of two strategies for timed intercourse in couples actively trying to conceive
raw_criteria:
Note: age limits are for female age only

Inclusion Criteria:

* Childless couples trying to conceive
* Relationship length \> one year

Exclusion Criteria:

* Couples that already had achieved a successful pregnancy
* Couples with children
